---
title: "Figure 1 side-legend layout preview"
format: html
---

Layout-only trial. Frozen plot objects and taxonomy colours are retained.
No live manuscript replacement or statistical reanalysis.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggplot2);library(grid)})
out <- commandArgs(TRUE)[1]; stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
root <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
a <- readRDS(file.path(root,"figure1_panels_2026-09-15-v1/source/review_panels.rds"))
n <- readRDS(file.path(root,"figure1D_radial_labels_2026-09-15-v3/source/network_plot.rds"))
n$layers <- Filter(function(l)!any(l$aes_params$label %in% c("Microbial hosts","Linked viral sequences")),n$layers)
for(i in seq_along(n$layers)) if(!is.null(n$layers[[i]]$aes_params$size)) n$layers[[i]]$aes_params$size <- n$layers[[i]]$aes_params$size*.70
n$coordinates$limits$y <- c(-1.9,1.95)
n <- n+theme(legend.text=element_text(size=6),legend.title=element_text(size=6),legend.spacing.y=unit(0,"mm"),legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),plot.caption=element_blank())
dir.create(file.path(out,"figures"),recursive=TRUE)
draw <- function(p,x,y,w,h) print(p,vp=viewport(x=x,y=y,width=w,height=h),newpage=FALSE)
pdf(file.path(out,"figures/figure1-sidelegend.pdf"),width=240/25.4,height=285/25.4,useDingbats=FALSE)
grid.newpage()
draw(a$M,.315,.739,.63,.51)
draw(a$V,.815,.866,.36,.255)
draw(a$bars,.812,.602,.365,.255)
draw(n,.703,.231,.59,.445)
for(i in 1:4) grid.text(LETTERS[i],x=c(.01,.642,.642,.414)[i],y=c(.989,.989,.748,.447)[i],just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=10,fontface="bold"))
scale <- function(x,y,pal,title,limits){cols<-pal(seq(0,1,length.out=40));for(i in 1:40)grid.rect(x=x-.12+.24*(i-.5)/40,y=y,width=.24/40,height=.005,gp=gpar(fill=cols[i],col=NA));grid.text(title,x=x,y=y+.015,gp=gpar(fontsize=7));grid.text(limits,x=c(x-.12,x+.12),y=y-.012,gp=gpar(fontsize=7))}
scale(.165,.462,a$mag$scales$get_scales("fill_ggnewscale_1")$palette,"A: completeness (%)",c("75","100"))
scale(.46,.462,a$mag$scales$get_scales("fill")$palette,"A: contamination (%)",c("0","25"))
grid.text("A, C, D: shared prokaryotic taxonomy",x=.012,y=.424,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=7,fontface="bold"))
k<-a$key; nr<-ceiling(nrow(k)/2)
for(i in seq_len(nrow(k))){cc<-(i-1)%/%nr;rr<-(i-1)%%nr;xx<-.014+cc*.20;yy<-.405-rr*.0105
grid.rect(x=xx,y=yy,width=.007,height=.0045,gp=gpar(fill=k$colour[i],col=NA));lab<-gsub(" \\[unresolved\\]"," *",gsub(" \\[remainder\\]"," +",k$display_category[i]));grid.text(lab,x=xx+.006,y=yy,just="left",gp=gpar(fontsize=6.5))}
grid.text("* No deeper assignment\n+ Other assignments within phylum",x=.012,y=.018,just=c("left","bottom"),gp=gpar(fontsize=6.5))
dev.off()
writeLines(c("Layout preview only; Google Doc unchanged.","Frozen MAG, vOTU, abundance, network and taxonomy objects retained.","Canvas 240 x 285 mm; two-column taxonomy key alongside network."),file.path(out,"REVIEW_STATUS.txt"))
```
